title: Design System: Pittsburgh Forge Rugby Club

motion.name: transition-fast
motion.purpose: Button background and field border transitions.

motion.name: transition-base
motion.purpose: Link color and nav underline transitions.

motion.name: nav-underline
motion.purpose: Gold underline sliding in from the left on nav hover.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid gold action button for the primary task on a surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; font-family: var(--font-noto-sans, "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; padding: 10px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background-color: var(--color-gold, #ffb81c); color: var(--color-black, #000); cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: var(--color-gold-400, #ffd75e); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-gold, #ffb81c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Dark grey button for secondary actions beside a primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; font-family: var(--font-noto-sans, "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; padding: 10px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; background-color: var(--color-grey-800, #343a40); color: var(--color-white, #fff); cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background-color: #4b5563; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-gold, #ffb81c); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Labelled text input with a gold focus ring and red invalid state.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; font-family: var(--font-noto-sans, "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif); } .ds-field-label { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-grey-900, #222); } .ds-field-control { width: 100%; max-width: 420px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #ccc; border-radius: 4px; background-color: var(--color-white, #fff); color: var(--color-grey-900, #222); font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.5; transition: border-color 0.2s; } .ds-field-control::placeholder { color: var(--color-grey-600, #6c757d); } .ds-field-control:focus { outline: 1px solid var(--color-gold, #ffb81c); border-color: var(--color-gold, #ffb81c); } .ds-field-control[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: var(--color-red, #c60c30); }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Inline status or label chip with a soft resting shadow.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 12px; font-family: var(--font-noto-sans, "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif); font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 500; background: var(--color-white, #fff); color: var(--color-grey-900, #222); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08); }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Header link whose gold underline slides in from the left on hover.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { position: relative; display: flex; font-family: var(--font-noto-sans, "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif); font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; padding: 16px 0; color: var(--color-white, #fff); text-decoration: none; overflow: hidden; } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: -1px; right: -1px; bottom: 0; height: 3px; background: var(--color-gold, #ffb81c); transform: translateX(-100%); transition: transform 0.3s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover::after, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible::after { transform: translateX(0); }

components.name: Dropdown Panel
components.description: Floating navigation panel with the system's one heavy shadow.
components.css: .ds-nav-panel { min-width: 260px; padding: 20px; background: var(--color-grey-900, #222); border: 1px solid var(--color-grey-700, #495057); border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-nav-panel-link { font-family: var(--font-noto-sans, "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif); font-size: 15px; color: var(--color-grey-100, #f8f9fa); text-decoration: none; padding: 4px 0; transition: color 0.3s ease; } .ds-nav-panel-link:hover { color: var(--color-gold, #ffb81c); }

narrative.overview: The system is built on Pittsburgh's black-and-gold sports grammar: a near-black field, a single hot gold that behaves like stadium light, and condensed Oswald headlines that read like a matchday program. It is not a generic rugby template and not a polished SaaS product — it is a club that has been around, competes, and fields both a women's and a men's side. The ambition is split by surface. Marketing surfaces lean gritty and proud: bold type, strong black/gold blocks, real photography, a gold rule that slides under a nav link like a scoreboard light. Data and commerce surfaces lean sharp and modern: tight radii, high contrast, legible forms, and no decoration competing with the task. Depth is deliberately flat. The page is a printed program, not a stack of floating cards; shadows appear only where something genuinely floats above the page or responds to state.
keyCharacteristics: Black-and-gold palette with one red reserved for error and required states.
Oswald for headings, Noto Sans for body and UI.
Flat surfaces; shadows only for floating elements and state.

rules.name: The Black-and-Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold marks action and identity — primary buttons, the nav underline, links on dark. It is not a decorative wash; keep it to accents and primary actions.

rules.name: The Signal Red Rule
rules.body: Red means something is wrong or required. Never use it for emphasis, brand, or decoration.

rules.name: The Oswald-For-Headings Rule
rules.body: Headings are Oswald; body and UI are Noto Sans. Never set body copy in Oswald.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only on floating elements and in response to state.

dos: Do use Stadium Gold for primary actions and the nav underline.
Do set headings in Oswald and body/UI in Noto Sans.
Do keep radii tight: 4px controls, 8px panels, 12px badges.
Do keep surfaces flat at rest and reserve shadows for floating elements and state.
donts: Don't use Signal Red for emphasis, brand, or decoration.
Don't introduce pill shapes or large corner radii.
Don't add ambient shadows to resting cards.
Don't set body copy in Oswald.
Don't apply Lemon Milk casually; it is reserved for brand/display moments.
